claim.quote: Our value of Q_W^p is in excellent agreement with the SM, and sets multi-TeV-scale constraints on any semi-leptonic PV physics not described within the SM.

key_value.note: Q_W^p as quoted in the abstract.
key_value.quote: Here we report Q_W^p=0.0719+-0.0045, as extracted from our measured parity-violating (PV) polarized electron-proton scattering asymmetry, A_ep=-226.5+-9.3 ppb.

name: Qweak: precision measurement of the weak charge of the proton

summary.plain: Qweak's final result: the proton's weak charge, which sets how strongly the proton feels the weak force, is 0.0719 ± 0.0045, in excellent agreement with the Standard Model and ruling out new semi-leptonic interactions up to multi-TeV mass scales.
summary.technical: Final Qweak result from the combined two run periods: parity-violating e-p asymmetry A_ep = -226.5 ± 9.3 ppb, giving Q_W^p = 0.0719 ± 0.0045, in excellent agreement with the Standard Model and setting multi-TeV-scale constraints on semi-leptonic parity-violating physics beyond it.

title: Precision Measurement of the Weak Charge of the Proton
why_it_matters: The weak charge of the proton is a precisely predicted Standard-Model quantity, so a precise measurement is an indirect search for new physics at mass scales above those reachable in direct collider searches.
